title: Texture evolution and mechanical properties of Ti4VHf2.5Ta2.5 reduced-activation refractory high-entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by high-vacuum arc-melting using high purity raw materials (≥ 99.95 %). Casted rods with 20 mm diameter were subjected to 90% cold rolling. Axis of round rod was perpendicular to rolling direction.

title: Texture evolution and mechanical properties of Ti4VHf2.5Ta2.5 reduced-activation refractory high-entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by high-vacuum arc-melting using high purity raw materials (≥ 99.95 %). Casted rods with 20 mm diameter were cold rolled to 2 mm thickness and annealed at 800°C for 1 h in air atmosphere.
